A skewer of delicious roasted fish and shellfish.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Seafood Skewers are made by [[Cooking]] at least one [[Crab]] or [[Snail]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. [[Link]] can make their default version can be made by utilizing [[Seafood]] that has contradicting effects. When eaten, they will restore some of Link's [[Heart]]s. The natural water in this [[Meal]] creates a delicious broth. To achieve a status effect from Seafood Skewers, several Ingredients of the same effect must be utilized. * '''Hearty Seafood Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Seafood Skewer}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The natural water in this medley of seafaring creatures makes for a delicious broth.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using any combination of [[Hearty Bass]] or [[Hearty Salmon]]s with [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s. They will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]] when eaten. * '''Energizing Seafood Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Seafood Skewer}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The natural water in this medley of seafaring creatures makes for a delicious broth.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Staminoka Bass]]es and [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s. Eating them will partially refill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Mighty Seafood Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Seafood Skewer}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The natural water in this medley of seafaring creatures makes for a delicious broth.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using any combination of [[Mighty Carp]] or [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]] with [[Ironshell Crab]]s. When eaten, Link will receive a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Tough Seafood Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Seafood Skewer}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The natural water in this medley of seafaring creatures makes for a delicious broth.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using any combination of [[Armored Carp]] or [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]] with [[Ironshell Crab]]s. Link will gain a boost to his defensive abilities when he eats these skewers. * '''Sneaky Seafood Skewer''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Seafood Skewer}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The natural water in this medley of seafaring creatures makes for a delicious broth.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s and [[Sneaky River Snail]]s. By eating them, Link will receive a boost to his [[Stealth]] abilities. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} [[Link]] can make Seafood Skewers by [[Cooking]] any type of [[Crab]] or a [[Sneaky River Snail]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Copious Seafood Skewers * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood, Skewers |items= BotW, TotK }}
